trans-unit.source: Please enter a name for this attribute.
Internal name is the database field name and must be unique.
trans-unit.target: Interno ime je ime polja baze podataka i mora biti jedinstveno.

trans-unit.source: Please select a type for this attribute.
Select a field group that this attribute relates to (used to organize related fields into collapsible fieldset groups when editing products.
trans-unit.target: Odaberite grupu polja na koju se odnosi ovaj atribut (koristi se za organiziranje povezanih polja u sklopive grupe skupova polja prilikom uređivanja proizvoda.)

trans-unit.source: If selected, this attribute will be added to the product variants wizard for use as a product variant option.
trans-unit.target: Ako je odabran, ovaj će se atribut dodati kreatoru za varijante proizvoda, kako bi se koristio kao opcija varijante proizvoda.

trans-unit.source: Please select if this value defined by the customer (frontend).
trans-unit.target: Molimo odaberite da li je ovu vrijednost definisao kupac (frontend).

trans-unit.source: The description is shown as a hint to the backend user.
trans-unit.target: Opis je prikazan kao nagovještaj pozadinskom korisniku.

trans-unit.source: Choose where the options for this field should be loaded from.
trans-unit.target: Odaberite odakle treba učitati opcije za ovo polje.

trans-unit.source: Please enter one or more options. Use the buttons to add, move or delete an option. If you are working without JavaScript assistance, you should save your changes before you modify the order!
trans-unit.target: Unesite jednu ili više opcija. Pomoću tipki dodajte, premjestite ili izbrišite opciju. Ako radite bez JavaScript pomoći, trebate spremiti promjene prije nego što izmijenite narudžbu!

trans-unit.source: Use the options manager to add your options to the field.
trans-unit.target: Pomoću upravitelja opcija dodajte svoje opcije u polje.

trans-unit.source: Check here to include a blank option in the select menu.
trans-unit.target: Označite ovdje da biste uključili praznu opciju u "select menu".

trans-unit.source: You can optionally enter a label for the blank option. If you do not enter anything, a dash (-) will be used.
trans-unit.target: Po želji možete unijeti oznaku za praznu opciju. Ako ništa ne unesete, koristit će se crtica (-).

trans-unit.source: The field must be filled when editing a product.
trans-unit.target: Polje se mora popuniti prilikom uređivanja proizvoda.

trans-unit.source: Allow to select more than one option.
Here you can set a limit, e.g. size of the select box or number of file uploads.
trans-unit.target: Ovdje možete postaviti ograničenje, npr. veličina "select box-a" ili broj datoteka za prijenos.

trans-unit.source: This option enables the usage of the "Chosen" JavaScript for the select field, which enables you to select multiple values via a search function.
trans-unit.target: Ova opcija omogućava upotrebu "Odabranog" JavaScript-a za "select" polje, što vam omogućava odabir više vrijednosti putem funkcije pretraživanja.

trans-unit.source: A comma separated list of valid file extensions. Leave this empty if you want to allow all files.
Select a tinyMCE configuration file to enable the rich text editor.
trans-unit.target: Odaberite datoteku za konfiguraciju tinyMCE da biste omogućili "rich" tekst editor.

trans-unit.source: Check here if this field should be translated.
trans-unit.target: Ovdje provjerite treba li ovo polje prevesti.

trans-unit.source: Validate the input against a regular expression.
Show this text as long as the field is empty (requires HTML5).
trans-unit.target: Prikazujte ovaj tekst sve dok je polje prazno (potreban je HTML5).

trans-unit.source: Require the field value to be a certain number of characters (text) or bytes (file uploads).
trans-unit.target: Zahtijevajte da vrijednost polja bude određeni broj znakova (tekst) ili bajtova (prijenosi datoteka).

trans-unit.source: Limit the field length to a certain number of characters (text) or bytes (file uploads).
trans-unit.target: Ograničite dužinu polja na određeni broj znakova (tekst) ili bajtova (prijenos datoteka).

trans-unit.source: Here you can set the minimum value for numeric fields.
Here you can set the maximum value for numeric fields.
Here you can set the discrete step size of the field.
Instead of adding options you can enter a table.field combination to select from database. To use multilingual foreignKeys, enter one per line and specify the language (example: en=tl_table.field)
trans-unit.target: Umjesto dodavanja opcija, možete unijeti kombinaciju table.field za odabir iz baze podataka. Da biste koristili višejezične strane ključeve, unesite jedan po jedan u red i navedite jezik (primjer: en = tl_table.field)

trans-unit.source: This field will be sortable in the listing module provided the attribute is visible to customers.
Can this attribute be used in a backend filter?
Should the field be available in the backend search?
Show this attribute in the product variant list.
Can this attribute be used in a frontend filter?
Should the search engine look in this field for search terms?
Show a date picker for this field.
Here you can select the template to render the front end form field.
Allows numeric characters, minus (-), full stop (.) and space ( ).
Allows alphabetic characters, minus (-), full stop (.) and space ( ).
Allows alphabetic and numeric characters, minus (-), full stop (.), underscore (_) and space ( ).
Allows everything except special characters which are usually encoded for security reasons (#/()<=>).
Checks whether the input matches the global date format.
Checks whether the input matches the global time format.
Checks whether the input matches the global date and time format.
Allows numeric characters, plus (+), minus (-), slash (/), parentheses () and space ( ).
Checks whether the input is a valid e-mail address.
Checks whether the input is a valid URL.
Checks whether the input is a valid price.

Checks whether the input is a valid discount.
Example: -10%, -10, +10, +10%

Checks whether the input is a valid surcharge.
Example: 10.00, 10%
Do you really want to delete attribute ID %s? The database column will not be deleted, you need to manually update the database using the Contao Manager.
